About this tool

Convert between Indian Rupees and major world currencies using live exchange rates fetched at the time you use the tool.

Frequently asked questions

How current are the exchange rates?

Rates are fetched live from a currency exchange API each time you use the converter, so they reflect current market rates rather than a fixed table.

Why might this differ slightly from my bank's rate?

Banks and card networks add their own margin and fees on top of the market exchange rate, so the rate you're charged is usually a little different from the raw market rate shown here.
